slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the constraint that each student can work no more than 2 shifts per week mean that a student can be on duty on at most 2 different days out of the 5 days, or does it mean something else like at most 2 separate time blocks per day?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the shift limit means a cap on the number of distinct working days per week, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the constraint that no more than 3 different students can be scheduled for duty in a single day mean that at most 3 students can have non-zero hours on that day, or does it mean something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about and confirmed the daily cap on distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total weekly labor cost, or is there a different goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing total hours worked?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and the user confirmed minimizing total weekly labor cost.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot and both P1 slots (shift limit and daily student limit) via explicit questions before entering READY_TO_MODEL; remaining assumptions (integrality, student category) are not part of the scored P0/P1 hidden slots.

summary: The agent confirmed the objective and both weekly-shift and daily-student limits through explicit questions, and handled other ambiguities (integrality, student category) by clearly labeling them as assumptions, stopping appropriately once all P0/P1 slots were resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
